label: SOURCE-BASED, UNVALIDATED (a reconciliation of two internal solvers, not a validation)

why.sun_pct: Same definition (share of the 337 hourly samples with the Sun centre above the skyline), same DEMs and ray steps; both float64. Bundle also reports an interval-based value (bisection-refined crossings) shown in brackets.
why.longest_gap_h: Bundle: longest run of hidden hourly samples (interval value from refined crossings in brackets). Batch: longest_sun_gap_steps from the 2026-11-14 run, which used float32 heights and was not re-run in float64.
why.clone_range: Bundle carries no clone sweep (scenarios = []); the viewer takes the clone range from the batch float64 rerun via the certainty sidecar.
why.certainty_height: Bundle carries no mast sweep (masts 1 m and 10 m are separate bundles); Certainty Height exists only in the batch sweep (masts listed).
why.coverage: Different sampling. Bundle derived.coverage: the controlling skyline sample at the nearest 0.5 deg bin (720 bins, one ray per bin centre) is tested for source == 'near_5m' (near-field cut at the 5 m tile edge). Batch Coverage Gauge: controlling cell per hour at the body azimuth tested against the tile's inscribed radius. Bin snapping and the tile-edge test differ, so the two are expected to differ by a few points.
